# Essential Satellites and Raster Products

+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+------------+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| Dataset                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       | Spatial Resolution                                           | Start Year | Temporal Resolution | Important Bands                                                                                     | Best For                                                                                           |

| Landsat Collection 2 (Landsat [5](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/LANDSAT_LT05_C02_T1_L2), [7](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/LANDSAT_LE07_C02_T1_L2#description), [8](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/LANDSAT_LC08_C02_T1_L2), [9](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/LANDSAT_LC09_C02_T1_L2)) | 30 m (15 m panchromatic)                                     | 1984       | 16 days             | Coastal (L8/9), Blue, Green, Red, NIR, SWIR1, SWIR2, Panchromatic, Thermal                          | Long-term change detection, spectral indices, historical analyses                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+------------+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Sentinel-2 MSI](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/COPERNICUS_S2_SR_HARMONIZED)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | 10 m (visible/NIR), 20 m (red-edge/SWIR), 60 m (atmospheric) | 2015       | \~5 days            | Coastal Aerosol, Blue, Green, Red, Red Edge 1-3, NIR, narrow NIR, Water Vapor, Cirrus, SWIR1, SWIR2 | High-resolution mapping, spectral indices, present day land conditions                             |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+------------+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Sentinel-1 SAR](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/COPERNICUS_S1_GRD)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               | 10 m                                                         | 2014       | 6-12 days           | VV, VH                                                                                              | Flood mapping, soil moisture, cloud-free imaging, infrastructure                                   |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+------------+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [MODIS (Terra & Aqua)](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/modis)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | 250m - 1km                                                   | 2000/2002  | Daily               | 36 spectral bands                                                                                   | Large-scale daily monitoring                                                                       |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+------------+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [NEON DEM](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/projects_neon-prod-earthengine_assets_DEM_001)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | 1 m                                                          | 2017       | Static              | Elevation                                                                                           | Terrain analysis, slope, aspect, hillshade                                                         |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+------------+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [ESA WorldCover](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/ESA_WorldCover_v200)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             | 10 m                                                         | 2020       | Annual              | Land cover class                                                                                    | Ready-to-use land cover                                                                            |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+------------+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [Dynamic World](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/GOOGLE_DYNAMICWORLD_V1)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           | 10 m                                                         | 2015       | Per Sentinel-2      | Water, Trees, Grass, Flooded Vegetation, Crops, Shrub, Built Area, Bare Ground, Snow/Ice            | Near real time land cover mapping and land cover change detection                                  |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+------------+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [ERA5- Land](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/ECMWF_ERA5_LAND_HOURLY)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | \~9 km                                                       | 1950       | Hourly              | Air temperature, precipitation, soil moisture, snow, wind, pressure, radiation, evapotranspiration  | Climate analyses                                                                                   |
+---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+--------------------------------------------------------------+------------+---------------------+-----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------+
| [RTMA (Real-Time Mesoscale Analysis)](https://developers.google.com/earth-engine/datasets/catalog/NOAA_NWS_RTMA)                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | \~2.5 km (CONUS)                                             | 2011       | Hourly              | Air temperature, dew point, wind speed, wind direction, precipitation, pressure, cloud cover        | Near-real-time weather analyses, operational environmental monitoring, high-resolution meteorology |
